items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Norman had the facility to listen to various players and pair them... I remember we were listening to one player... he'd say, 'boy he can play. I'd like to hear him with Little Jazz'

ctx.x: But that’s just one instance. In 1973 now, I’m sitting in a counter in Yugoslavia. I can’t even remember which city it was. Backstage. Because you know they have a place for artists to have a drink and some food backstage. But people from the theater can come back through a door and you can get into the theater through a door. And they were standing there with stacks of LP’s. And I signed each one. And Norman, sitting beside me right here at the bar, and I said, “you know you are very much responsible for this,…
He had great insight. Norman had great insight.
